name: What should I wear or bring to a Restorative Yoga class at Cave Training?
description: Wear comfortable, layered clothing. All props are provided at Cave Training, but you can bring your own mat if preferred. Arrive early and bring water.

mainEntity.name: What should I wear or bring to a Restorative Yoga class at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a Restorative Yoga class, wear comfortable, loose-fitting clothing that allows for ease of movement and relaxation. Layers are recommended as body temperature can drop during deep relaxation. You might also want to bring warm socks or a light sweater. While Cave Training provides all necessary props like bolsters, blankets, and blocks, you are welcome to bring your own mat if you prefer. We encourage you to arrive a few minutes early to settle in, set up your space, and mentally prepare for relaxation. Hydration before and after class is also beneficial. Bringing a water bottle is a good idea.
